body: To avoid merge conflicts: only the Pi's nightly jobs write these files; the cloud reads them after pull. Multi-outcome scenario sets (MACRO, ANTIGRAVITY gold) stay out of automatic scoring and are scored by hand at resolve date (multi-class Brier). Gold paper calls now auto-resolve via new resolver kind price_level (GC=F).
title: Pi owns scheduled-job outputs (research_notes/Scoreboard/*, SCOREBOARD block in memory/curriculum.md, research_notes/Live, india_pead_live); cloud stops writing them; scenario sets scored by hand
